'''Cookies''' are [[products]] unlocked at [[experience]] level 10.

Cookies are used to make [[cheesecake]], [[Fried Candy Bar|fried candy bars]], [[Cookie Cupcake|cookie cupcake]] and [[Vanilla Milkshake|vanilla milkshake]].

Like all [[products]], they are stored in the [[barn]].

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Making cookies'''===
[[File:Bakery.png|150px|left|link=Bakery|Bakery]]
Cookies are made in the [[Bakery]].

To make a cookie, players need the following ingredients, in the specified quantities:
{| border="0" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="1" style="text-align: center; margin: .5em 0;"
|-
|[[File:Wheat.png|75px|Wheat|link=Wheat]]
|[[File:Egg.png|75px|Eggs|link=Egg]]
|[[File:Brown Sugar.png|75px|link=Brown Sugar|Brown sugar]]
|-
|'''x2'''
|'''x2'''
|'''x1'''
|}
It takes 1 hour to make one cookie, and 51 minutes in a fully [[Masteries|mastered]] Bakery. Each cookie gives players 13 {{Infoicon|xp}} points.

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Selling cookies'''===
[[File:Roadside Shop.png|150px|left|link=Roadside Shop|Roadside Shop]]
* Cookies can be bought or sold for a maximum price of 1,044 {{Infoicon|Coin}} for 10 units.
* Buying the ingredients required to make a cookie costs 74 {{Infoicon|Coin}}.

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Using cookies'''===
Cookies are used to make the following [[products]]:

{{Item Usage|Cookie
|Snowflake Gift|1|17|temp=Snowflake Gift|tempend=20230102
|Cheesecake|1|24
|Fried Candy Bar|1|100
|Cookie Cupcake|2|114
|Vanilla Milkshake|2|124
}}

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Boat orders'''===
[[File:Riverboat.png|150px|left|link=Boat|Riverboat]]
* [[Boat]] orders ask for 1 to 5 cookies per crate, up to a total of 16 per boat.

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
* Cookies are very hard to find in the [[Daily Dirt]].

{{Clr}}
